entities.summary: The Rama language is one of the Indigenous languages of the Chibchan family spoken by the Rama people on the island of Rama Cay and south of lake Bluefields on the Caribbean coast of Nicaragua. Other Indigenous languages of this region include Miskito and Sumu. Rama is one of the northernmost languages of the Chibchan family. It is spoken in Honduras and Nicaragua.
